record.field: Cash flow forecast of the user's company computed by Odoo: opening cash, money in and out per week or month by category (open customer invoices, open vendor bills, forecast lines by source: sales orders, purchase orders, contracts, recurring costs, VAT, manual), overdue items, running balance and the lowest point. With realistic=true, open customer invoices are moved by each customer's average payment delay. Use these figures as they are; do not add them up yourself.

Actual cash flow statement of the user's company per month, computed by Odoo from the bank and cash accounts: money in and out by category (customers, suppliers, taxes, wages and other liabilities, other operating, investments, financing, other), internal transfers left out, with opening and closing cash.
